messages:
leo-partner: Quick heads-up 4: Marketplace team asked for a new private-offer pilot to drive appliance customers into the marketplace. Idea: a hybrid structure with an initial credit + ongoing renewal discount ladder tied to commit retention. Want SI and HW alignment before we go to field.

jenna-finance: Love the hybrid. Key finance asks: 1) how do we revenue-recognize the upfront credit vs rebate, 2) what triggers rollback on renew discounts if commit drops. Need SKU mapping and a reconciliation cadence.

omar-ops: Operational concerns: marketplace listings can take 10-14 business days for review in some regions. If we want co-announcements timed with private-offer activation, factor that lag. Also request we add `mp_offer_flow` tag to track listing state.

rita-si: From SI POV, migrations cost us time. If you want SI buy-in we need either co-funded migration credits or a success-based rebate. Prefer the success-rebate model (pays out after 30/60/90 day verified cutover).

tom-marketing: For joint announcement, we need at least one verified customer story and quote. Recommend planning announcement 8-10 weeks post-activation to collect metrics. Also can produce a partner FAQ and one-pager.

legal-bot: Reminder: include termination/clawback language and limit any forward-looking performance promises. I'll attach a short clause we can reuse.

leo-partner: Draft pilot terms (sketch):
```
offer_type: private-offer pilot
term: 12 months
upfront_credit: 2x customer average monthly consumption applied month 1-2
renewal_discount_ladder: month 13 renewal discount tiered by commit retention: >=90% => 15% discount, 70-89% => 10%, 50-69% => 5%
si_success_rebate: optional add-on, pays 30/50/20% at 30/60/90 days post cutover
listing_timing: allow 3-4w for marketplace review before co-announcement
reporting_tag: mp_offer_flow, surge_meta_{offerid}
clawback: prorated repayment if customer terminates in first 6 months
```

jenna-finance: That ladder looks workable. Two notes: call the upfront credit a "migration allowance" in docs so it's clear it's not a price discount for recognition. We also need a reconciliation file from marketplace with `surge_meta_{offerid}` usage per month.

rita-si: Agree on rebate cadence. One ask: can we get a SKU-level uplift mapping so SI can propose a trade-in price for old appliances?

omar-ops: I'll add `mp_offer_flow` to the backlog, ETA 2w for tagging + reporting view. Marketplace ops: please flag any region-specific listing constraints.

tom-marketing: I'll draft partner FAQ + a 1-pager exec summary. We should include conservative expected outcomes messaging (avoid hard lift numbers).

leo-partner: Action items: 
- Jenna: confirm revenue recognition label + reconciliation fields by Fri
- Omar: add tags + reporting backlog item (2w)
- Rita: send SI candidate list and trade-in asks by Mon
- Tom: draft announcement timeline + FAQ (first pass in 5 days)
- Legal: post the standard clawback snippet to the doc

legal-bot: Clawback snippet uploaded: https://redwood-internal.docs/legal/clawback-standard (partners-only).

leo-partner: Cool. If we align SI co-funding we can run a small pilot with 3 customers and a joint case study. Scheduling a 30m alignment next Tue. Thanks all.
